items.title: AI-Generated Images Discourage Me from Reading Your Blog
items.whyItMatters: AI image overlays on blog posts are making articles feel disposable — a case study in why original design matters for keeping readers engaged.

items.title: Born Against, or why hobby programming communities are against LLM usage
items.whyItMatters: Hobby programming communities are pushing back against LLM usage. A read on the cultural divide between open-source folks and AI tooling.

items.title: Thanks FedEx, This Is Why We Keep Getting Phished (2024)
items.whyItMatters: FedEx's email infrastructure created a phishing vector that attackers still exploit. A reminder that supply-chain security is everyone's problem.

items.title: Beating GPT-5.6 Sol on retrieval with 100x cheaper open models
items.whyItMatters: Open models beating frontier LLMs on retrieval at 1/100th the cost — practical signal that cheaper doesn't mean worse for real workloads.

items.title: TIME Is Serving AI Bots a Different Website, with Ads Built In
items.whyItMatters: TIME serves AI crawlers a different, ad-loaded site. Raises the question of whether the open web is being quietly split into human and bot versions.
